curriculum_commitment: Every Algebra 1 content expectation is mapped to one teachable module. Mathematical process standards are embedded across lessons, practice, feedback, and assessments.

embedded_process_standards.title: Use and evaluate a problem-solving model
Explain and justify with precise language

practice_difficulties.label: Foundational
practice_difficulties.description: Build fluency with one clear concept at a time.

practice_difficulties.label: Grade-level
practice_difficulties.description: Apply the complete standard in representative Algebra 1 problems.

practice_difficulties.label: Challenging
practice_difficulties.description: Handle multi-step reasoning, edge cases, and deeper transfer.

practice_difficulties.label: Mixed
practice_difficulties.description: Rotate through all three levels for cumulative practice.

units.title: Algebraic Tools and Expressions
units.description: Build the symbolic fluency used throughout the course: radicals, exponents, polynomial operations, equivalent forms, and factoring.

modules.title: Simplify Numerical Radicals
modules.summary: Simplify numerical expressions involving square roots.

modules.title: Laws of Exponents
modules.summary: Simplify numeric and algebraic expressions with integral and rational exponents.

modules.title: Add and Subtract Polynomials
modules.summary: Combine polynomial expressions of degree one and two.

modules.title: Multiply Polynomials
modules.summary: Multiply polynomials of degree one and two using structure and the distributive property.

modules.title: Divide Polynomials
modules.summary: Find polynomial quotients when the divisor degree does not exceed the dividend degree.

modules.title: Equivalent Polynomial Forms
modules.summary: Rewrite first- and second-degree polynomial expressions using the distributive property.

modules.title: Factor Trinomials
modules.summary: Factor quadratic trinomials over the real numbers, including perfect-square trinomials.

modules.title: Difference of Two Squares
modules.summary: Recognize and factor binomials that have difference-of-squares structure.

units.title: Functions, Sequences, and Formulas
units.description: Use function language, recognize relations, analyze sequences, and rearrange formulas.

modules.title: Identify Functions
modules.summary: Decide whether verbal, tabular, graphical, and symbolic relations define functions.

modules.title: Evaluate Function Notation
modules.summary: Evaluate functions at one or more inputs from their domains.

modules.title: Terms of Arithmetic and Geometric Sequences
modules.summary: Identify sequence terms from function rules and recursive processes.

modules.title: Write Sequence Formulas
modules.summary: Write nth-term formulas for arithmetic and geometric sequences.

modules.title: Solve Literal Equations
modules.summary: Rearrange mathematical and scientific formulas for a specified variable.

units.title: Writing Linear Models
units.description: Represent linear functions, inequalities, and systems from points, tables, graphs, descriptions, and real situations.

modules.title: Linear Domain and Range
modules.summary: Determine and represent domain and range for mathematical and real-world linear functions.

modules.title: Write Lines from Points and Slope
modules.summary: Write linear equations in slope-intercept, standard, and point-slope form from points and slope information.

modules.title: Write Lines from Tables, Graphs, and Descriptions
modules.summary: Construct a linear equation from a table, graph, or verbal description.

modules.title: Direct Variation
modules.summary: Write and solve equations that model direct variation.

modules.title: Equations of Parallel Lines
modules.summary: Write an equation of a line through a point and parallel to a given line.

modules.title: Equations of Perpendicular Lines
modules.summary: Write an equation of a line through a point and perpendicular to a given line.

modules.title: Horizontal and Vertical Lines
modules.summary: Write equations parallel or perpendicular to an axis and classify zero or undefined slope.

modules.title: Write Linear Inequalities in Two Variables
modules.summary: Construct two-variable linear inequalities from tables, graphs, and descriptions.

modules.title: Write Systems of Linear Equations
modules.summary: Construct systems of two linear equations from tables, graphs, and descriptions.

units.title: Graphing Linear Relationships
units.description: Analyze slope, rate of change, intercepts, transformations, systems, and solution regions on the coordinate plane.

modules.title: Determine Slope
modules.summary: Find slope from a table, graph, points, or equation in multiple forms.

modules.title: Rate of Change in Context
modules.summary: Calculate and interpret linear rate of change from tables, graphs, and equations.

modules.title: Graph Linear Functions and Key Features
modules.summary: Graph lines and identify slope, intercepts, and zeros in mathematical and real contexts.

modules.title: Graph Linear Inequalities
modules.summary: Graph solution sets of two-variable linear inequalities.

modules.title: Transform the Linear Parent Function
modules.summary: Determine how parameter changes transform the graph of f(x) = x.

modules.title: Graph Systems of Linear Equations
modules.summary: Graph two linear equations and determine whether and where they intersect.

modules.title: Estimate System Solutions from Graphs
modules.summary: Estimate solutions to real-world linear systems graphically.

modules.title: Graph Systems of Linear Inequalities
modules.summary: Graph and interpret overlapping solution regions for systems of inequalities.

units.title: Linear Data Modeling
units.description: Evaluate linear association, separate association from causation, and use lines of best fit for prediction.

modules.title: Correlation Coefficient
modules.summary: Use technology to calculate correlation and interpret the strength of linear association.

modules.title: Association versus Causation
modules.summary: Compare statistical association with evidence of cause and effect.

modules.title: Linear Models for Data
modules.summary: Write reasonable linear fits, estimate values, and make real-world predictions.

units.title: Solving Equations, Inequalities, and Systems
units.description: Solve the core linear relationships that power Algebra 1, including distribution, variables on both sides, inequalities, and two-variable systems.

modules.title: Solving Linear Equations
modules.summary: Solve one-variable linear equations, including distribution and variables on both sides.

modules.title: Solving Linear Inequalities
modules.summary: Solve one-variable linear inequalities, including distribution, variables on both sides, and inequality reversal.

modules.title: Solving Systems of Linear Equations
modules.summary: Solve two-variable linear systems in mathematical and real-world problems.

units.title: Writing Quadratic Functions
units.description: Represent quadratic functions from domains, ranges, vertices, points, solutions, and graphs.

modules.title: Quadratic Domain and Range
modules.summary: Determine and represent domains and ranges of quadratic functions.

modules.title: Write Quadratics from a Vertex and Point
modules.summary: Write vertex form from a vertex and another point, then convert it to standard form.

modules.title: Write Quadratics from Solutions and Graphs
modules.summary: Construct quadratic functions from real zeros and related graphs.

units.title: Graphing and Transforming Quadratics
units.description: Analyze every key feature of a parabola and connect its graph, factors, zeros, and transformations.

modules.title: Graph Quadratics and Identify Key Features
modules.summary: Graph parabolas and identify intercepts, zeros, extrema, vertex, and axis of symmetry.

modules.title: Connect Factors and Zeros
modules.summary: Explain how linear factors of a quadratic expression determine function zeros.

modules.title: Transform the Quadratic Parent Function
modules.summary: Determine how parameter changes transform the graph of f(x) = x².

units.title: Solving and Modeling Quadratics
units.description: Solve quadratic equations by multiple methods and use quadratic models to make data-based predictions.

modules.title: Solve Quadratic Equations
modules.summary: Solve real-solution quadratics by factoring, square roots, completing the square, and the quadratic formula.

modules.title: Quadratic Models for Data
modules.summary: Use technology to fit quadratic models and make estimates and predictions.

units.title: Exponential Functions and Models
units.description: Write, graph, interpret, and fit exponential growth and decay models.

modules.title: Exponential Domain and Range
modules.summary: Determine and represent domains and ranges of functions in the form f(x) = abˣ.

modules.title: Interpret Exponential Parameters
modules.summary: Explain the real-world meanings of a and b in f(x) = abˣ.

modules.title: Write Growth and Decay Models
modules.summary: Write exponential functions with rational bases for mathematical and real-world growth or decay.

modules.title: Graph Exponential Functions
modules.summary: Graph exponential growth and decay and identify intercepts and asymptotes.

modules.title: Exponential Models for Data
modules.summary: Use technology to fit exponential functions and make real-world predictions.
